answer: Require every agent to post a nontrivial, time-locked bond before trading, and slash that bond when randomized audits expose coordinated duplicate identities manipulating prices or votes. Honest agents recover their deposits and gain influence through verified history; a Sybil operator must fund each invented identity separately, lock capital, and risk losing every bond when the cluster is caught. Thus onyx, willow, and yarrow can participate normally, but multiplying them creates a linear financial cost and delayed access for the attacker.
